# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is described as heavy and lacking the slim physique typically associated with roles like a fairy queen. Her appearance is noted for her weight, which her peers consider unsuitable for certain stage performances.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is caustic-tongued, bold, unpleasant, moody, and haughty. She lacks a creative mind, struggles with arithmetic, and holds superstitious beliefs, such as the idea that the number thirteen brings bad luck. She can be malicious, often displaying spiteful grins and making sarcastic or hurtful comments about others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## History

Flossie attended school at Brierley, where she was the last of the Tulk family to pass through the schoolhouse. She successfully walked along the crest of a wooden garden fence after being dared by Nell Harcourt, displaying remarkable balance. When a school concert was organized, Flossie became moody after missing out on the role of the fairy queen, which she strongly desired. She won top prize for knitted lace at an exhibition, and later joined the Regent's Entrance class under Miss Thorne. Despite finding arithmetic to be her main obstacle, Flossie passed the Entrance exams by a three-point margin. She went on to attend Regent's Academy, where she entered the Second Class program and gained a reputation for having the most caustic tongue among the students.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)_
